## Mayor Tony Wu

It is an honor and a privilege to be your mayor. I am deeply humbled by the trust you have placed in me, and I am eager to serve the city we all love.

West Covina is more than a place; it is a community. A vibrant, diverse, and dynamic community that reflects the best of Southern California. From our thriving businesses to our family-friendly neighborhoods, we are a city full of potential and pride.

Today, as I take this oath, I renew my commitment to every resident of West Covina. I pledge to work tirelessly to ensure our city is safe, prosperous, and inclusive. Together, we will focus on:

1. Economic Development: Supporting local businesses, attracting new investments, and creating opportunities for growth.
2. Public Safety: Enhancing resources for our police, fire, emergency services and public health to ensure every resident feels secure and safe.
3. Community Engagement: Listening to your voices, addressing your concerns, and fostering an open and transparent government.
4. Quality of Life: Improving infrastructure, parks, and public services to make West Covina an even better place to live, work, and raise a family.

I know this work cannot be done alone. I am committed to collaborating with the City Council, community leaders, and all of you to achieve our shared vision for West Covina. Together, we will face challenges with determination and celebrate achievements with pride.

As we look to the future, let us remember that our strength lies in our unity. By working together, respecting our differences, and focusing on what unites us, we can achieve great things.

I would like to take a moment to thank my family and friends for their unwavering support. To my colleagues and mentors who have guided me, and most importantly, to the residents of West Covina, thank you for believing in me. 

I am honored to serve as your mayor and excited to get to work on behalf of this wonderful city. Together, we can ensure that West Covina continues to be a shining example of community spirit, resilience, and opportunity.

Thank you, and let’s get started on this journey together.
